facts.fact: AdWave recommends that startups start paid advertising with small budgets of $10-50 per day and increase spend only when promising signals appear.
facts.quote: Start with small budgets ($10-50/day) and increase only when you see promising signals.

facts.fact: AdWave states that Connected TV advertising lets startups run commercials on streaming services such as Hulu, Peacock, and Tubi starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: lets startups run commercials on streaming services like Hulu, Peacock, and Tubi starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that startups can launch campaigns on 100+ premium channels.
facts.quote: launch campaigns on [100+ premium channels](https://adwave.com/channels/) with budgets that work for early-stage companies.

facts.fact: The page states that startups can test TV advertising for as little as $30 a day with platforms like Adwave.
facts.quote: you can test TV advertising for as little as $30 a day with platforms like Adwave

facts.fact: The page says meaningful paid experiments for search or social advertising start around $500-$1,000 per month.
facts.quote: meaningful experiments start around $500-$1,000/month for search or social

facts.fact: The page defines the Bootstrap Mode budget tier for early-stage startups as $0-$1,000 per month.
The page suggests small retargeting budgets under $200 per month in the bootstrap stage.
facts.quote: Small retargeting budgets (under $200/month) capture warm visitors.

facts.fact: The page defines the Seed Stage budget tier for startups as $1,000-$5,000 per month.
The page defines the Series A+ budget tier as $5,000-$25,000+ per month.
The page defines payback period as how long it takes a customer to generate enough revenue to recover acquisition cost.
facts.quote: Payback period shows how long until a customer generates enough revenue to recover acquisition cost.

facts.fact: The page advises that startups should expect at least 2-3 months of experimentation before finding reliable customer acquisition approaches.
facts.quote: Expect at least 2-3 months of experimentation before finding reliable customer acquisition approaches.

facts.fact: The page states that some channels, such as content marketing, take 6-12 months to show significant results.
facts.quote: Some channels like content marketing take 6-12 months to show significant results.

facts.quote: Create a TV ad](https://adwave.com/try-free/) that builds credibility and reaches your target audience, starting at just $30 a day.
